planning_boundary: One bounded trust/consumer slice only: query-explain-answer-debug. Do not add broad SAP content, new ready domains, LLM answer generation, network source verification, or copied SAP documentation in this plan.
why_now: query-explain already exposes retrieval ranking evidence, and consumer JSON examples now describe downstream use. The missing bounded proof is a consultant-answer decision trace that explains why output is ready or needs_curation and which profile support evidence was kept or dropped.
must_preserve: Generated and machine-consumable artifacts stay JSON/JSONL-first.
Ready answers require class-specific citeable support, not any top-k source.
needs_curation remains draft-only and must not become tenant/release/customizing proof.
No SAP Help mirror, tenant data, screenshots, exports, credentials or proprietary copied documentation.

requirements: R-1: Expose classification, profile status, support filtering, kept/dropped support ids, required citation ids and status reasons in consultant-answer output.
R-2: Keep existing status/classification/citation behavior unchanged.
R-3: Preserve fail-closed boundaries for generic, tenant, release and customizing prompts.
acceptance: Ready answers include decision_trace.status=ready and a ready status reason.
needs_curation answers include decision_trace.status=needs_curation and a fail-closed status reason.
CLI JSON output includes the same decision_trace contract.
verification: uv run sap-agent-context consultant-answer "How should API reporting work?" --limit 12
